none: PAS CAM-965512: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Constantine, (contemporary copy). Mint is uncertain. AD335-341 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows 2 Soldiers, one Standard. Obverse shows draped, head left. Obverse legend reads [....]. Condition worn. Weight 0.84g,diameter 10.31mm
